en_before: Our guide to layering women’s outfits explains how to balance the pieces. Choose the outer layer around the journey so its length works both while worn and when stored between different stops. Let one hem show deliberately if you like the effect. Several layers ending at the same spot around the hips can make the outfit feel busier than you want.
